exposure: Types of ventricular septal defects (VSDs) (isolated, non-isolated, muscular, non-muscular, with intracardiac structural anomalies, with extra-cardiac structural anomalies)
cohort: Fetuses diagnosed with ventricular septal defects (VSDs) whose mothers underwent amniocentesis and had low-risk non-invasive prenatal testing, excluding those with high-risk NIPT results or genetic disorders.
finding: The incidence of pathogenic copy-number variations (CNVs) was lower in isolated ventricular septal defects (VSDs) compared to non-isolated VSDs in a low-risk non-invasive prenatal testing (NIPT) condition, and isolated muscular VSDs usually do not require surgery.
